The most recently created plans, newest first (ties broken by id, descending), each in exactly the shape of GET /capacity-plans/\{id\}, one keyset page at a time (limit + cursor; follow nextCursor until it is absent). `location` restricts the list to one location (repeat it on every page request); omitted means every location. 200 with an empty items list when nothing matches. Read-only; there is no MCP tool for it.
